# charly cardwire — the cardwire GPU-manager surface

`charly cardwire` drives `ogc/cardwire` — the Open Gaming Collective's eBPF/LSM
GPU-blocking daemon (CachyOS/Arch first). Served by `candy/plugin-cardwire`
(`command:cardwire`).

## Command tree

- `charly cardwire status` — a deterministic, GPU-less-graceful host report: the
  `cardwired` systemd state, the `/etc/cardwire/cardwire.toml` whitelisted keys
  (`auto_apply_gpu_state`, `experimental_nvidia_block`, `battery_auto_switch`,
  `battery_auto_switch_mode`, `external_display_auto_switch`), and the BPF-LSM facts
  read directly from `/sys/kernel/security/lsm`.
- `charly cardwire list` — the managed GPUs.
- `charly cardwire config` — the effective configuration.
- `charly cardwire gpu <id> block|unblock` — block/unblock a GPU.
- `charly cardwire manager` — the manager daemon state.

## When to use it

To inspect or drive the GPU-blocking daemon; confirm BPF-LSM readiness first with
`charly bpf lsm`.
